scope: Present sent messages as compact conversation entries
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--transcript-start-compact-d.task: Distinguish authored messages from replies while retaining copy and selectable content.
conversation--transcript-start-compact-d.observations: The sent request uses a shorter card with a clearly readable Copy message action and retained author label. At 760 px the full one-line request remains visible and the reply heading has more clearance above the composer. Dark panel contrast is distinct. No clipping or overlapping controls.
